purpose: Audit a SpaceClaim .scscript archive for package structure, metadata, operation tokens, and unsafe recorded aliases.
trigger: A .scscript archive is available for read-only host checks before it is handed to a SpaceClaim environment.

inputs.name: archive_path
inputs.description: Path to the .scscript ZIP archive to inspect.

inputs.name: require_api
inputs.description: Optional API metadata value that must match the archive.

inputs.name: forbid_numbered_aliases
inputs.description: Whether recorded BodyN, FaceN, EdgeN, or similar numbered aliases must fail the audit.

inputs.name: required_operations
inputs.description: Optional operation tokens that must occur in executable script text.

inputs.name: forbidden_operations
inputs.description: Optional operation tokens that must not occur in executable script text.

inputs.name: report_path
inputs.description: Optional path for the JSON audit result emitted by the command-line interface.

preconditions: archive_path identifies a file that can be opened for read-only inspection.
Any required or forbidden operation tokens are complete dotted identifiers and are case-sensitive.
report_path, when supplied, is writable and is not the input archive.

outputs.name: audit_result
outputs.description: Structured host audit result with status, members, metadata, token counts, aliases, and issues.

outputs.name: report_path
outputs.description: The optional JSON report file when report_path was supplied.

postconditions: audit_result is emitted even when an input check fails and contains a machine-readable status and issue list.
A passed audit has all required archive members, valid content-type declarations, non-empty metadata, and no error-level policy findings.
When report_path is supplied, the file contains the same structured audit result that is emitted to standard output.

implementation.target_environment: Host Python 3.9 or newer; reads a .scscript ZIP archive without launching SpaceClaim.
implementation.notes: Numbered aliases and policy tokens are inspected as text; no geometry object is resolved and no application execution is observed.

ambiguity_checks: No geometry objects are selected; archive member names and executable token text are the only inspected structures.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Not applicable because the operation has no geometry topology effect.

failure_modes.condition: archive_path does not identify a readable file.
failure_modes.detection: Check the path before opening the ZIP archive.
failure_modes.safe_state: No archive contents are trusted and status is failed.

failure_modes.condition: The ZIP has unsafe member names, encryption, excessive size, corruption, or duplicate members.
failure_modes.detection: Apply archive safety limits and CRC/member checks before reading executable content.
failure_modes.safe_state: The archive remains unopened for execution and status is failed.

failure_modes.condition: Required members, content-type overrides, script text, or version metadata are missing or invalid.
failure_modes.detection: Check required members and metadata after safe archive loading.
failure_modes.safe_state: The audit result records the failure and does not approve the package.

failure_modes.condition: A required operation is absent, a forbidden operation is present, or forbidden numbered aliases are found.
failure_modes.detection: Tokenize executable text after masking comments and strings, then evaluate declared policy.
failure_modes.safe_state: The archive is not promoted for the requested policy.

failure_modes.condition: The optional report_path resolves to the input archive.
failure_modes.detection: Compare canonical real paths before writing the JSON report.
failure_modes.safe_state: The archive remains byte-for-byte unchanged, the result is emitted to standard output, and status is failed.

failure_modes.condition: The optional report_path cannot be written.
failure_modes.detection: Handle the filesystem error when persisting the JSON result.
failure_modes.safe_state: The in-memory/stdout result remains the only available result and write failure is reported.

recovery.action: Provide a readable archive path and rerun the audit.
Regenerate or repair the archive and rerun the safety audit before any execution attempt.
Repair the package members or metadata and rerun the audit on the clean archive.
Resolve the reported token or alias issue, or revise the declared policy with explicit review, then rerun.
Choose a report destination that does not resolve to the input archive and rerun without changing the archive.
Choose a writable report destination and rerun without changing the archive.

validation.method: Run repository audit_scscript host tests against valid and malformed archives.
validation.expected: Required members, ZIP safety limits, CRC checks, and required content-type overrides are enforced.

validation.method: Run repository audit_scscript host tests covering required/forbidden tokens, comments and strings, and numbered aliases.
validation.expected: Only executable dotted tokens are counted and policy violations produce the documented status and issue.

validation.check: Report output cannot overwrite the input archive
validation.method: Run the command-line host test with report_path equal to archive_path.
validation.expected: The command fails with report_path_collision and preserves the original archive bytes.

evidence_refs.notes: Public contract review record; no private model or host path is included.

design_only.notes: The contract is case-neutral and limited to deterministic static archive checks.

evidence_refs.notes: Twenty-two repository unit tests passed for this exact tool and contract revision.

host_checked.notes: Host static-audit checks only; no SpaceClaim process was launched.

geometry_measurements.notes: The auditor does not inspect model geometry.

visual_review.notes: No viewport or image is reviewed.

evidence_level.notes: Formal evidence stops at design_only and host_checked for this host-only operation.
